support.title: Partner with Spurgeon TV
support.subtitle: Help us spread the gospel through the sincere and biblical works of Charles Haddon Spurgeon.
support.body: Spurgeon TV is a labor of love dedicated to translating, preserving, and distributing Spurgeon's complete works to humanity for free. However, keeping this massive library online requires significant ongoing resources. Your contributions directly cover our vital operational costs: server hosting, domain renewals, platform maintenance, system updates, and the complex translation processes required to make these sermons available in multiple languages. By partnering with us, you are not just maintaining a website—you are actively helping to announce the gospel of Christ to the world.
support.otherWaysTitle: 🤝 You can also support this mission in other ways:

otherWays.text: Pray for our project, our team, and for God to guide every translation and design decision.
Share Spurgeon TV with friends, family, and communities who hunger for deep, biblical preaching.
Help us improve by pointing out errors or suggestions in translations, content, or the website.

devotional.pageSubtitle: Read the classic daily devotional by Charles Spurgeon, with inspiring readings for the morning and evening.
devotional.comingSoon: We are preparing the complete and interactive digital version of this classic devotional. Soon, you will be able to read the daily portion directly here, with bible links and multiple translations.
devotional.introText: Written over a century ago, 'Morning and Evening' remains one of the most read and loved devotionals worldwide. Spurgeon distills the essence of the gospel into two short, profound daily messages filled with the love of Christ.
